CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   C. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   C. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.
   C. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
   B. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain My Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Adam and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
